game.title: Divinity: Original Sin - Enhanced Edition
game.blurb: Party-based, turn-based fantasy RPG with co-op, from Larian Studios, released 2015-10-27. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: RPG, Indie. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The story from start to finish. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden on Steam.

chapters.title: Visible Story Milestones
chapters.summary: Finding a primary suspect, passing a test, the four elements, reaching Phantom Forest and Hunter's Edge, entering the Gnik Barc Nni and finishing the game.

chapters.title: Honour, Tactician and Lone Wolf
chapters.summary: Finishing the game in tactician mode, in honour mode and with the Lone Wolf trait.

chapters.title: Skills and Oddities
chapters.summary: Mastering a skill tree, pushing a certain button and a silky souvenir.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page under "Divinity: Original Sin" or "Divinity: Original Sin Enhanced Edition". divinity.fandom.com answers the API under "Divinity: Original Sin", with about 20 linked pages, including "Divinity: Original Sin (Enhanced Edition)", "Original Sin Quests" and "Original Sin Locations"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema names the app "Divinity Original Sin Enhanced Edition". 41 of 54 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions, so the main story chapter holds 41 placeholders; many of them are probably quests or side goals, but nothing says which. The 7 visible story milestones sit in their own chapter. "Never Say Die" (honour mode, 0.8%) is the rarest achievement.
